row:
This channel will serve as a reference guide for veterinary medicine students. Lectures are from students and faculty and they are tailored according to the typical content of the course syllabi for a veterinary medicine course. 

Your lecturer is Garry Lasaga, a veterinary faculty from the Philippines.
